start.provenance: SET FROM EDITOR: starter example, against the south wall in RED's half, 4 in west of the centre line, facing the hive, so it drives straight north to scoreSouth; measure your own start tile

scoreNorth.provenance: SET FROM EDITOR: starter example, north of the RED hive on x = -13, outside the legal approach margin, facing the up cell once the first tip has turned it north; 8 in farther from the hive than scoreSouth, so a robot coming round the west side of the hive frame has room to turn in toward the cell
